thinkers.name: Isaac Newton
thinkers.mechanism: Prism spectrum decomposition, calculus, laws of motion, Opticks experimental rigor
thinkers.transfer: Physics-first rendering, spectral light transport, measured curves over RGB hacks

thinkers.name: Robert Sapolsky
thinkers.mechanism: Behave / Determined: behavior is the product of biology plus layered environmental history
thinkers.transfer: Environment-attribution rule: training/incentive history produces model behavior

thinkers.name: Ludwig von Bertalanffy
thinkers.mechanism: General Systems Theory: open systems maintained by continuous flux, equifinality
thinkers.transfer: Dynamic complex systems, open-loop living software, reseating valves

thinkers.name: Socrates
thinkers.mechanism: Elenchus, examined life, knowing what one does not know
thinkers.transfer: Flywheel honest nulls / UNVERIFIABLE / calibrated uncertainty

thinkers.name: Claude Shannon
thinkers.mechanism: Entropy, channel capacity, noise floor, lossless source coding
thinkers.transfer: Isomorphism (zero-entropy signal transmission), mode budgets, compression & recall

thinkers.name: Srinivasa Ramanujan
thinkers.mechanism: Deep intuitive synthesis of modular identities, partitions, continued fractions verified by Hardy
thinkers.transfer: J-lens creative synthesis paired with Hardy/Crucible/Lean formal oracles ('Models Propose, Oracles Dispose')

thinkers.name: Richard Feynman
thinkers.mechanism: First-principles clarity, path integrals, cargo-cult science warning ('first principle: do not fool yourself')
thinkers.transfer: Path-traced ground-truth references, planted-failure controls, anti-self-deception

thinkers.name: Jonathan Rauch
thinkers.mechanism: The Constitution of Knowledge (error-correction institutions, no final authority)
thinkers.transfer: Nothing self-warrants; external independent checking in Flywheel & CMMNS

thinkers.name: Charles & Ray Eames
thinkers.mechanism: Powers of Ten, Mathematica, joyful rigor, contrast/space/shadow, honest materials
thinkers.transfer: HarperZ9.github.io design synthesis, multi-scale visual explainers

thinkers.name: Khalil Gibran
thinkers.mechanism: Poetic clarity on stewardship, children, work, and freedom
thinkers.transfer: Next-generation stewardship and human-centered design voice

thinkers.name: Alan Turing
thinkers.mechanism: Universal computation, reaction-diffusion morphogenesis, the child machine
thinkers.transfer: Developmental learning, reaction-diffusion shaders, computability limits on gatekeepers

thinkers.name: Leonhard Euler
thinkers.mechanism: Graph theory, Euler characteristic V-E+F, fluid equations, complex exponentials
thinkers.transfer: Fluid solvers, polytope geometry, harmonic analysis in superframe & RAW

thinkers.name: Gaston Bachelard
thinkers.mechanism: Water and Dreams, Poetics of Space, epistemological obstacle, reverie
thinkers.transfer: Low Water spatial poetics, reverie spaces where measurement turns off by design

thinkers.name: M. C. Escher
thinkers.mechanism: Plane symmetry groups, hyperbolic tilings, woodcut value control
thinkers.transfer: Superframe plane-group riffs, hatching & ink shaders

thinkers.name: William James
thinkers.mechanism: The Meaning of Truth, pragmatism, cash-value of ideas in experience
thinkers.transfer: Evidence, insight, and useful work rule: work counts when it changes a real outcome

thinkers.name: Andrei Tarkovsky
thinkers.mechanism: Sculpting in Time, Nostalghia slow pull-back reveals, water/rain/fire/memory
thinkers.transfer: Low Water cinematography, held-time pacing, environmental storytelling

thinkers.name: Plato
thinkers.mechanism: Forms, the cave, dialogue as dialectic method
thinkers.transfer: Latent structure vs rendered projection; Plato's Key / Forum structured debate

thinkers.name: George Orwell
thinkers.mechanism: Politics and the English Language; plain prose exposing obfuscation
thinkers.transfer: Articulate (ARTIQL8) anti-slop prose standard

thinkers.name: Kurt Godel
thinkers.mechanism: Incompleteness: no consistent formal system proves its own consistency
thinkers.transfer: CREDO: nothing holds itself up; external witnesses and second-party checks

thinkers.name: Wassily Kandinsky / Paul Klee / Hilma af Klint / Gustav Klimt
thinkers.mechanism: Bauhaus pedagogy, broken mosaic color, geometric diagrams of vibration and harmony
thinkers.transfer: Dynamic color palettes, stipple/weave shaders, diagram design

thinkers.name: Andrey Kolmogorov
thinkers.mechanism: Kolmogorov complexity (shortest program = compression), turbulence scaling, probability axioms
thinkers.transfer: Compression-as-understanding, turbulence in RAW clouds/water/fire

thinkers.name: Benoit Mandelbrot
thinkers.mechanism: Fractal geometry of nature, rough multi-scale self-similarity
thinkers.transfer: Procedural terrain, glaciers, clouds, trees, and multi-scale Fisher geometry

thinkers.name: Jack Rakove
thinkers.mechanism: Original Meanings; institutional checks, balances, and power dispersion
thinkers.transfer: Valves, fail-safes, and eliminating single points of failure

thinkers.name: Lilian Weng / Melanie Mitchell / Berg
thinkers.mechanism: Rigorous technical synthesis; skepticism of anthropomorphic interpretability metaphors
thinkers.transfer: Research-Synthesis-Method.md; treating internal readouts as untrusted instruments

thinkers.name: Charles Sanders Peirce
thinkers.mechanism: Abduction, pragmatic maxim, fallibilism, scientific realism
thinkers.transfer: Hypothesis -> falsification -> iterative convergence in Crucible & Flywheel

thinkers.name: Emmy Noether
thinkers.mechanism: Noether's theorem: every differentiable symmetry corresponds to a conservation law
thinkers.transfer: Symmetry/asymmetry auditing, conservation laws in physics & rendering

thinkers.name: Hermeticism (Hermes Trismegistus)
thinkers.mechanism: Correspondence ('as above, so below'), vibration, polarity, rhythm, cause and effect, macrocosm-microcosm
thinkers.transfer: Multi-scale fractal/isomorphic architecture ('turtles all the way down')

thinkers.name: John von Neumann
thinkers.mechanism: Stored-program architecture, cellular automata, game theory, numerical stability
thinkers.transfer: Deterministic architecture, BuildLang OS/emulator, multi-agent mechanism design

thinkers.name: Karl Friston
thinkers.mechanism: Free Energy Principle, active inference, Markov blankets
thinkers.transfer: Action-gated developmental world models (wmm-4) and precision-weighted sensing

thinkers.name: Rene Descartes
thinkers.mechanism: Radical doubt, analytic geometry, clear and distinct verification
thinkers.transfer: Zero-trust re-derivable receipts; coordinate geometry

thinkers.name: Fyodor Dostoevsky / Leo Tolstoy / Anton Chekhov
thinkers.mechanism: Deep interiority, moral friction, realism without sentimentality, human dignity under systems
thinkers.transfer: Low Water narrative weight and everyman-observer voice

thinkers.name: Arthur Schopenhauer
thinkers.mechanism: Will and representation; music as direct copy of the will
thinkers.transfer: Generative audio/harmonics as primary engine layer, not decorative afterthought

thinkers.name: Friedrich Nietzsche
thinkers.mechanism: Critique of herd conformity and unexamined moral consensus
thinkers.transfer: Independent adversarial evaluation against consensus echo chambers

thinkers.name: J. M. W. Turner / Ivan Aivazovsky / Pieter Bruegel
thinkers.mechanism: Atmospheric storm light, translucent sea waves, crisp winter silhouettes in snow
thinkers.transfer: RAW & Low Water weather, storm coast, snow town visual references

thinkers.name: Isaac Asimov
thinkers.mechanism: Three Laws edge-case failure analysis, psychohistory, radical clarity in science communication
thinkers.transfer: Edge-case adversarial testing of AI rules; accessible public science writing

thinkers.name: Walt Disney Fantasia / Eyvind Earle / Karel Zeman
thinkers.mechanism: Audio-visual synthesis, flat-graphic depth layers, engraved composite worlds
thinkers.transfer: Audio-reactive rendering, engraved/ink 3D registers

thinkers.name: Aristotle
thinkers.mechanism: Four causes (material, formal, efficient, final), categories, golden mean, observation before theory
thinkers.transfer: Properties over property; physical-first classification; balanced elasticity/plasticity

thinkers.name: Michel Foucault
thinkers.mechanism: How institutions and environments construct subjects and regimes of truth
thinkers.transfer: Environment-attribution rule: systems and incentives produce agent behavior

thinkers.name: Alexander Grothendieck
thinkers.mechanism: Functoriality, sheaves, topoi: understand objects by their morphisms and relationships
thinkers.transfer: Estuary relational architecture, category/isomorphism maps across tools

thinkers.name: Bret Victor
thinkers.mechanism: Explorable explanations, direct manipulation of live mathematical models
thinkers.transfer: HarperZ9.github.io interactive studies, Estuary, RAW Live Studio

thinkers.name: Dietrich Bonhoeffer
thinkers.mechanism: Costly grace, theory of stupidity under power, view from below, action under unjust order
thinkers.transfer: Just-culture valves, resisting institutional coercion and dishonesty

thinkers.name: Epicurus
thinkers.mechanism: Ataraxia, the art of enough, non-extractive sufficiency
thinkers.transfer: Non-extractive design returning people to their time

thinkers.name: Giovanni Battista Piranesi & Etienne-Louis Boullee
thinkers.mechanism: Monumental sublime scale, Carceri light shafts, pure geometric volumes
thinkers.transfer: Low Water monument ground and cathedral-scale industrial lighting

thinkers.name: Harry Frankfurt
thinkers.mechanism: On Bullshit (indifference to truth vs lying)
thinkers.transfer: Flywheel distinguishing fluent LLM confabulation from verified ground truth

thinkers.name: Ivan Sutherland / Alan Kay / Ted Nelson
thinkers.mechanism: Sketchpad reactive constraints, Dynabook / Smalltalk live objects, Xanadu transclusion/pointers
thinkers.transfer: One reactive BuildLang core, zero-copy SHA-256 pointers, anti-silo workstation

thinkers.name: Jonny Thomson
thinkers.mechanism: Mini Philosophy, The Art of Enough; accessible synthesis of philosophical diagnostics
thinkers.transfer: Accessible public education (Night School & HarperZ9.github.io)

thinkers.name: Michael Levin
thinkers.mechanism: Bioelectric morphogenesis, multiscale competency, platonic space of forms
thinkers.transfer: Multi-scale self-repairing architectures and biological vocabulary in software

thinkers.name: Pyrrho / Pyrrhonian Skeptics
thinkers.mechanism: Epoche (suspension of judgment), 'I do not know' as precision
thinkers.transfer: UNDECIDED / UNVERIFIABLE as first-class Flywheel verdicts

thinkers.name: Robert Musil
thinkers.mechanism: Intelligent stupidity (institutional blindness inside technical competence)
thinkers.transfer: P2 narrow-check illusion: passing tests while missing the real failure

thinkers.name: Walter Benjamin
thinkers.mechanism: Aura, mechanical reproduction, distraction vs contemplation
thinkers.transfer: Reverie rooms, provenance-locked media, craft over mass-produced AI slop
